lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ},
  Differentiable ℝ f →
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f →
      ∀ {β δ : NNReal},
        LipschitzWith β (gradient f) →
          ∀ (u : E),
            have W := fun x => f x + ↑δ / 2 * ‖x - u‖ ^ 2;
            Differentiable ℝ W ∧
              StrongConvexOn Set.univ (↑δ) W ∧
                (∀ (x : E), gradient W x = gradient f x + ↑δ • (x - u)) ∧ LipschitzWith (β + δ) (gradient W)
approved_definition_context: E has a real inner product with its induced norm and is complete. Differentiable R f means everywhere Frechet differentiable; gradient is the actual Riesz gradient of that derivative.
ConvexOn R Set.univ f means f((1-t)x+t y)<=(1-t)f(x)+t f(y) for every x,y and t in [0,1]. StrongConvexOn Set.univ m f uses the additional subtraction (m/2)t(1-t)||x-y||² on that right hand side.

NNReal denotes nonnegative real numbers including zero. LipschitzWith K g means dist(g(x),g(y))<=K*dist(x,y) for all x,y. Scalar multiplication is denoted by a dot. Local have-bindings define expressions.
